text:
Anya: quick sync — launching "RefKit: Local Vector Starter" next week. Need final blog + tutorial, benchmark narrative, webinar tie-in, and inbound routing. Rough timeline: blog & tutorial Tue, webinar Wed, announce Thur. Who can own benchmark write + routing?

Ben: I got tutorial + repo PR. I can draft the benchmark narrative but need perf outputs from eng. Draft repo (WIP): https://github.com/redwood/refkit-starter :point_right:

Julia: I can do assets / hero screenshots. Need final build for screenshot by MON EOD. Any UI tweaks, ping me.

Mike: I can own inbound routing. Plan: webinar signups -> marketing MQL queue; devrel leads get CRM tag `refkit_interest` and assigned to Ben for follow-up. Need registration form fields list.

Sam: I'll kick off perf runs on infra side. Can someone share the bench command we want run (model, seq, qps)?

Ben: perf commands below — this is what I used last time, tweak as needed:
```bash
./run_bench.sh --model=rw-13b --mode=hosted --seq=512 --qps=50 --duration=600 > hosted.csv
./run_bench.sh --model=rw-13b --mode=dedicated --seq=512 --qps=50 --duration=600 > dedicated.csv
```

Anya: perfect — benchmark narrative should highlight: 1) cost per 1M tokens (hosted vs dedicated), 2) p95 latency delta, 3) operational levers (batching, KV cache, quantization) + a short callout about predictable capacity for Dedicated. Keep it 3 bullets and 1 chart.

Ben: will draft that. Target: PR to content repo by MON 12:00 PT. I'll include a short TL;DR for social.

Julia: will produce hero + 2 supporting screenshots and a 1200x628 image for LinkedIn/Twitter. Deliver by MON 5pm PT.

Mike: webinar logistics — propose WED 11am PT. Speakers: Ben (demo), Chris (infra), Anya (intro). I can moderate. Does that work?

Anya: yes, WED 11am PT works. Add a 30-min prep call Tue 4pm PT.

Sam: I'll upload perf CSVs to the shared folder and attach logs. Aim to have them by MON 9:00 PT. Also will include the raw metrics and the script used to collect them.

Mike: registration form fields to capture for routing: `email`, `company`, `role`, `use_case` (dropdown), `company_size` (dropdown), `interested_in_dedicated` (checkbox). We'll map `interested_in_dedicated=true` to enterprise SDR pool.

Ben: noted — will add follow-up CTA in tutorial + a checkbox in the webinar slide for Dedicated interest.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `content-site/staging -> production` at 2026-03-30T18:00Z :rocket:

Anya: recap / owners — Ben: tutorial + benchmark narrative + PR (due Mon 12:00 PT), Julia: assets (Mon 5pm PT), Sam: perf runs + CSV (Mon 9:00 PT), Mike: inbound routing + webinar moderation, Anya: copy + social variants + announce. Ping me with blockers. :thumbsup:

Ben: will start drafting now, will ping eng for logs.

Julia: added to my calendar.

Mike: creating the registration page and CRM mapping now. Will share link when ready.

Sam: starting perf run in 10m, will post progress here.

Anya: thanks team — this feels good. We'll sync Tue 4pm for prep.
